item.title: 💬 'Even from the basements, we take them out and destroy. There is no mercy for them'
item.description: 'Even from the basements, we take them out and destroy. There is no mercy for them' 💬 Unmanned systems battalion serviceman with the call sign 'Bely' told how our lads liberated Annovka in the Donetsk People's Republic. ▫️ The operation was performed out of central casting. Experienced commanders led assault groups into the settlement during the night, and UAV operators actively covered their comrades from heavy Ukrainian copters. ▫️ The enemy hid the UAV command posts in the residential buildings of Dobropolye and tried to strike back, but Russian drones forced AFU servicemen to go out even from fortified basements. ↗️ The liberation of Annovka opened the Tsentr Group's servicemen a direct path to Dobropolye and a further way to the borders of the Donetsk People's Republic. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 📍 The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
item.description: The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation. 📍 The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation. The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Nikolskoye, Kiyanitsa, and Ulanovo (Sumy region). 💥 In Kharkov region , strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade close to Pisarevka, Slatino, Izbitskoye, Prikolotnoye, and Sosnovy Bor (Kharkov region). ▪️ The AFU losses amounted to more than 245 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, and eight motor vehicles. 📍 The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions. Russian troops launched strikes at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Grushevka, Andreyevka, Prokopovka (Kharkov region), Karpovka, Rubtsy, and Lozovoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ▪️ The enemy losses amounted to more than 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles. ↗️ The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line. Formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade were defeated near Kramato
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29128

The Armed Forces of the Russian Federation continue the special military operation.
📍
The Sever Group of Forces improved its tactical situation.
The Group's units inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of one mechanised brigade, one airmobile brigade of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade near Nikolskoye, Kiyanitsa, and Ulanovo (Sumy region).
💥
In Kharkov region
, strikes were delivered at formations of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU and one territorial defence brigade close to Pisarevka, Slatino, Izbitskoye, Prikolotnoye, and Sosnovy Bor (Kharkov region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to more than 245 troops, five armoured fighting vehicles, and eight motor vehicles.
📍
The Zapad Group of Forces took more advantageous lines and positions.
Russian troops launched strikes at manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and one territorial defence brigade have been hit close to Grushevka, Andreyevka, Prokopovka (Kharkov region), Karpovka, Rubtsy, and Lozovoye (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy losses amounted to more than 190 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, and 12 motor vehicles.
↗️
The Yuzhnaya Group of Forces improved the tactical situation along the front line.
Formations of three mechanised brigades, one motorised infantry brigade, two airmobile brigades, one assault regiment of the AFU, and one territorial defence brigade were defeated near Kramatorsk, Novoselovka, Klinovoye, Slavyansk, Kondratovka, and Druzhkovka (Donetsk People's Republic).
▪️
The enemy lost up to 205 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, 28 motor vehicles, and seven artillery guns, including one U.S.-made 155-mm M777 howitzer.
📍
The Tsentr Group of Forces improved the tactical situation.
They inflicted losses on manpower and hardware of two mechanised brigades, one jaeger brigade, one assault brigade of the AFU, one marine brigade, and three national guard brigades close to Andreyevka, Belozerskoye, Fedorovka, Dobropolye (Donetsk People's Republic) and Ivanovka (Dnepropetrovsk region).
▪️
The AFU losses amounted to up to 370 troops, two armoured fighting vehicles, nine motor vehicles, and one field artillery gun.
👉

🔹

item.title: ▫️ Night is his element: the feat of the crew of Aziz Kudryakov During the special military operation,
item.description: Night is his element: the feat of the crew of Aziz Kudryakov ▫️ During the special military operation, his crew carried out 437 sorties, most of them under cover of darkness. Kudryakov destroyed the enemy's tanks and SAM systems, demonstrating the highest professionalism. 🚁 The last manoeuvre: defeating the enemy in Kursk border, the crew of the commander, Aziz Kudryakov, and the navigation officer, Mikhail Lazis, used all ammunition during the flight. When they were on their way to the base, they saw an enemy drone rushing into the residential sector, and they decided to perform ram manoeuver. ▫️ The crew sacrificed itself to save hundreds of civilians from death. ▫️ By presidential decree, the commander of the crew, Aziz Kudryakov, was awarded the title of Hero of the Russian Federation (postmortem). The navigation officer Mikhail Lazis was awarded the Order for Courage (postmortem). 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 🛠 Front-line inventors in action The Zapad Group of Forces deployed a workshop to assemble and modernise drones
item.description: Front-line inventors in action 🛠 The Zapad Group of Forces deployed a workshop to assemble and modernise drones in Krasny Liman direction. ➡️ How the work is organised: ▫️ Case-by-case approach. Craftsmen modernise every drone manually. They upgrade the construction and upload unique OS to make it perform a specific task. ▫️ Maximum speed. A prepared drone doesn't stay in a warehouse. Craftsmen immediately send it to the front line. ▫️ Rapid reaction. Closeness to the front line makes it possible to respond instantly to any change in the situation. Our units receive the necessary equipment without delay. ▫️ With such craftsmen, our servicemen will hit any targets! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ✏️ Taking care of our future The servicemen of the Tsentr Group of Forces and volunteers from the Volga region handed over backpacks with office supplies and school uniforms to the
item.description: Taking care of our future ✏️ The servicemen of the Tsentr Group of Forces and volunteers from the Volga region handed over backpacks with office supplies and school uniforms to the students of the Donetsk Rehabilitation Centre on the occasion of the Knowledge Day. 📕 The centre was also gifted with a school album found under the rubble in Avdeyevka: after restoration, it will be sent to the museum as a symbol of the return to peaceful life. The children sang to their guests, and our servicemen promised to continue to support them. ❤️ 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://t.me/mod_russia_en/29119

Taking care of our future
✏️

📕
